ne5ed9ee1ac.headline: Portugal recorded the largest drop in industrial production in the EU in November
ne5ed9ee1ac.summary: Portugal experienced the largest decline in industrial production in the European Union in November, while the EU and eurozone also showed declines compared to October but maintained positive year-on-year growth.
ne5ed9ee1ac.why: Industrial production is a key economic indicator reflecting manufacturing sector health and overall economic activity, affecting investor sentiment and policy decisions in Portugal and the EU.

ne5ed9ee1ac.original_headline: Portugal registou a maior queda da produção industrial na UE em Novembro

nf77a4bd238.headline: Egypt’s Amer sees import rules saving $20 billion in 2016
nf77a4bd238.summary: Egypt’s central bank governor said new import restrictions could save about $20 billion this year, easing foreign exchange pressures and supporting economic recovery.
nf77a4bd238.why: Reducing unnecessary imports helps improve Egypt’s trade balance and foreign currency reserves, critical for stabilizing the economy and attracting investment.
